versions.subject: Merge PR #4406 from @nasbench - Multiple Updates & Additions
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\WinRAR.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Local\Temp\Rar$'
    TargetFilename|re: '\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,4} \.'
condition: selection
